statement:
theorem Step.toStandardForm {p : Program} {s s' : State} (hstep : Step p s s') :
    Step p.toStandardForm s s' ∨
    (s'.isHalted p ∧ ∃ s₂, Step p.toStandardForm s s₂ ∧
      s₂.isHalted p.toStandardForm ∧ s'.regs = s₂.regs) :=
proof_text:
by
  cases hstep with
  | zero hinstr =>
    left
    exact Step.zero (by simp [Program.getElem?_toStandardForm, hinstr])
  | succ hinstr =>
    left
    exact Step.succ (by simp [Program.getElem?_toStandardForm, hinstr])
  | transfer hinstr =>
    left
    exact Step.transfer (by simp [Program.getElem?_toStandardForm, hinstr])
  | @jump_ne m n q hinstr hne =>
    left
    have hcap : p.toStandardForm[s.pc]? = some (Instr.J m n (min q p.length)) := by
      simp [Program.getElem?_toStandardForm, hinstr]
    exact Step.jump_ne hcap hne
  | @jump_eq m n q hinstr heq =>
    have (x : ℕ) (h : min q p.length = x) : p.toStandardForm[s.pc]? = some (Instr.J m n x) := by
      grind [Program.getElem?_toStandardForm, Instr.capJump]
    by_cases q ≤ p.length
    · grind [Step.jump_eq]
    · right
      split_ands
      · grind [State.isHalted]
      · use ⟨p.length, s.regs⟩
        grind [State.isHalted, Program.toStandardForm_length]

statement:
theorem Steps.toStandardForm_halts {p : Program} {s s' : State}
    (hsteps : Steps p s s') (hhalted : s'.isHalted p) :
    ∃ s₂, Steps p.toStandardForm s s₂ ∧
      s₂.isHalted p.toStandardForm ∧ s'.regs = s₂.regs :=
proof_text:
by
  induction hsteps using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
  | refl =>
    refine ⟨s', .refl, ?_, rfl⟩
    simp only [State.isHalted, Program.toStandardForm_length]
    exact hhalted
  | head hstep hrest ih =>
    rcases Step.toStandardForm hstep with
      hsame | ⟨hhalted_mid, s_mid, hstep_mid, hhalted_mid', hregs_eq⟩
    · obtain ⟨s₂, hsteps₂, hhalted₂, hregs_eq⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨s₂, .trans (.single hsame) hsteps₂, hhalted₂, hregs_eq⟩
    · grind [Steps.eq_of_halts .refl hhalted_mid hrest hhalted]

statement:
theorem Halts.toStandardForm {p : Program} {inputs : List ℕ} (h : Halts p inputs) :
    Halts p.toStandardForm inputs :=
proof_text:
by
  obtain ⟨s, hsteps, hhalted⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨s₂, hsteps₂, hhalted₂, _⟩ := Steps.toStandardForm_halts hsteps hhalted
  exact ⟨s₂, hsteps₂, hhalted₂⟩

statement:
theorem Step.from_toStandardForm {p : Program} {s s' : State} (hstep : Step p.toStandardForm s s') :
    Step p s s' ∨
    (s'.isHalted p.toStandardForm ∧ ∃ s₂, Step p s s₂ ∧ s₂.isHalted p ∧ s'.regs = s₂.regs) :=
proof_text:
by
  cases hstep with
  | jump_eq hinstr _ =>
    simp only [Program.getElem?_toStandardForm, Option.map_eq_some_iff] at hinstr
    obtain ⟨instr, _⟩ := hinstr
    cases instr with
    | J => grind [=> jump_eq]
    | _ => grind
  | _ => grind [getElem?_toStandardForm, Option.map_eq_some_iff]

by
  induction hsteps using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
  | refl =>
    refine ⟨s', by rfl, ?_, rfl⟩
    simp only [State.isHalted, Program.toStandardForm_length] at hhalted ⊢
    exact hhalted
  | head hstep hrest ih =>
    rcases Step.from_toStandardForm hstep with
      hsame | ⟨hhalted_mid, s_mid, hstep_mid, hhalted_mid', hregs_eq⟩
    · obtain ⟨s₂, hsteps₂, hhalted₂, hregs_eq⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨s₂, .trans (.single hsame) hsteps₂, hhalted₂, hregs_eq⟩
    · rename_i s_next
      have hrest_trivial : s_next = s' := Steps.eq_of_halts .refl hhalted_mid hrest hhalted
      subst hrest_trivial
      exact ⟨s_mid, .single hstep_mid, hhalted_mid', hregs_eq⟩

statement:
theorem Halts.of_toStandardForm {p : Program} {inputs : List ℕ}
    (h : Halts p.toStandardForm inputs) : Halts p inputs :=
proof_text:
by
  obtain ⟨s, hsteps, hhalted⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨s₂, hsteps₂, hhalted₂, _⟩ := Steps.from_toStandardForm_halts hsteps hhalted
  exact ⟨s₂, hsteps₂, hhalted₂⟩

statement:
theorem Halts.toStandardForm_iff {p : Program} {inputs : List ℕ} :
    Halts p inputs ↔ Halts p.toStandardForm inputs :=
proof_text: ⟨Halts.toStandardForm, Halts.of_toStandardForm⟩

statement:
theorem evalState_toStandardForm_regs {p : Program} {inputs : List ℕ}
    (hp : (evalState p inputs).Dom) (hq : (evalState p.toStandardForm inputs).Dom) :
    ((evalState p inputs).get hp).regs =
      ((evalState p.toStandardForm inputs).get hq).regs :=
proof_text:
by
  have ⟨hsteps, hhalted⟩ := evalState_spec p hp
  have ⟨hsteps', hhalted'⟩ := evalState_spec p.toStandardForm hq
  obtain ⟨s₂, hsteps₂, hhalted₂, hregs_eq⟩ := Steps.toStandardForm_halts hsteps hhalted
  rw [Steps.eq_of_halts hsteps' hhalted' hsteps₂ hhalted₂, hregs_eq]

statement:
theorem eval_toStandardForm {p : Program} {inputs : List ℕ} :
    eval p inputs = eval p.toStandardForm inputs :=
proof_text:
by
  simp only [eval]
  apply Part.ext'
  · simp only [Part.map_Dom]
    exact Halts.toStandardForm_iff
  · intro hp hq
    simp only [Part.map_get, Function.comp_apply, Regs.output,
               evalState_toStandardForm_regs hp hq]

statement: theorem toStandardForm_equiv (p : Program) : p.toStandardForm ≈ p :=
proof_text: fun _ => eval_toStandardForm.symm

by
  intro i hi
  simp only [List.mem_append] at hi
  rcases hi with hi | hi <;> [exact hp i hi; exact hq i hi]

by
  intro i hi
  simp only [List.mem_cons] at hi
  rcases hi with rfl | hi <;> [exact hinstr; exact hp i hi]

statement:
theorem Program.IsStraightLine.singleton {instr : Instr}
    (h : ¬instr.IsJump) : Program.IsStraightLine [instr] :=
proof_text:
by
  intro i hi
  simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hi

statement:
theorem Step.of_nonJump {p : Program} {s : State} (hlt : s.pc < p.length)
    (hnonjump : ¬(p[s.pc]'hlt).IsJump) :
    ∃ s', Step p s s' ∧ s'.pc = s.pc + 1 :=
proof_text:
by
  cases hp : (p[s.pc]'hlt) with
  | Z n =>
    use {pc := s.pc + 1, regs := s.regs.write n 0}
    grind
  | S n =>
    use { pc := s.pc + 1, regs := s.regs.write n (s.regs.read n + 1) }
    grind
  | T m n =>
    use { pc := s.pc + 1, regs := s.regs.write n (s.regs.read m) }
    grind
  | J _ _ _ => grind [Instr.IsJump]

statement:
theorem straight_line_halts_from_regs {p : Program} (hsl : p.IsStraightLine) (r : Regs) :
    ∃ s, Steps p ⟨0, r⟩ s ∧ s.isHalted p ∧ s.pc = p.length :=
proof_text:
by
  suffices h : ∀ s : State, s.pc ≤ p.length → ∃ s', Steps p s s' ∧ s'.pc = p.length by
    obtain ⟨s', hsteps, hpc'⟩ := h ⟨0, r⟩ (Nat.zero_le _)
    exact ⟨s', hsteps, Nat.le_of_eq hpc'.symm, hpc'⟩
  intro s hpc_le
  generalize hrem : p.length - s.pc = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing s
  by_cases hhalted : s.pc ≥ p.length
  · grind
  · grind [Program.IsStraightLine, Step.of_nonJump, Relation.ReflTransGen.head]

statement:
theorem straight_line_halts {p : Program} (hsl : p.IsStraightLine) (inputs : List ℕ) :
    Halts p inputs :=
proof_text:
by
  obtain ⟨s, hsteps, hhalted, _⟩ := straight_line_halts_from_regs hsl (Regs.ofInputs inputs)
  exact ⟨s, hsteps, hhalted⟩

statement:
theorem straightLine_finalState_spec {p : Program} (hsl : p.IsStraightLine) (r : Regs) :
    let s := straightLine_finalState hsl r
    Steps p ⟨0, r⟩ s ∧ s.isHalted p ∧ s.pc = p.length :=
proof_text: Classical.choose_spec (straight_line_halts_from_regs hsl r)

statement:
theorem straightLine_finalRegs_eq_of_halted {p : Program} (hsl : p.IsStraightLine)
    (r : Regs) (s : State) (hsteps : Steps p ⟨0, r⟩ s) (hhalted : s.isHalted p) :
    s.regs = straightLine_finalRegs hsl r :=
proof_text:
Steps.eq_of_halts hsteps hhalted (straightLine_finalState_spec hsl r).1
    (straightLine_finalState_spec hsl r).2.1 ▸ rfl

statement:
theorem straight_line_state_at_pc {p : Program} (hsl : p.IsStraightLine)
    (r : Regs) (targetPc : ℕ) (htarget : targetPc ≤ p.length) :
    ∃ s, Steps p ⟨0, r⟩ s ∧ s.pc = targetPc :=
proof_text:
by
  induction targetPc with
  | zero => exact ⟨⟨0, r⟩, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih => grind [Step.of_nonJump, Program.IsStraightLine]

statement: theorem deterministic : Relator.RightUnique (Step p) :=
proof_text: by grind [Relator.RightUnique]

statement: theorem no_step_of_halted {s s' : State} (hhalted : s.isHalted p) : ¬Step p s s' :=
proof_text:
by
  grind [State.isHalted]

statement:
theorem preserves_register {s s' : State} {r : ℕ}
    (hstep : Step p s s')
    (hr : ∀ instr, p[s.pc]? = some instr → instr.writesTo ≠ some r) :
    s'.regs.read r = s.regs.read r :=
proof_text:
by
  cases hstep with
  | zero hinstr | succ hinstr | transfer hinstr =>
    have := hr _ hinstr
    simp only [Instr.writesTo, ne_eq, Option.some.injEq] at this
    exact Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm this) _ _
  | jump_eq _ _ | jump_ne _ _ => rfl

statement:
theorem isHalted_iff_normal {p : Program} {s : State} :
    s.isHalted p ↔ Relation.Normal (Step p) s :=
proof_text:
by
  constructor
  · intro hhalted ⟨s', hstep⟩
    exact Step.no_step_of_halted hhalted hstep
  · intro hnormal
    by_contra hnothalted
    simp only [State.isHalted, not_le] at hnothalted
    have hlt : s.pc < p.length := hnothalted
    have hinstr : p[s.pc]? = some p[s.pc] := List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt
    cases hp : p[s.pc] with
    | Z n => exact hnormal ⟨_, Step.zero (hp ▸ hinstr)⟩
    | S n => exact hnormal ⟨_, Step.succ (hp ▸ hinstr)⟩
    | T m n => exact hnormal ⟨_, Step.transfer (hp ▸ hinstr)⟩
    | J m n q =>
      by_cases heq : s.regs.read m = s.regs.read n
      · exact hnormal ⟨_, Step.jump_eq (hp ▸ hinstr) heq⟩
      · exact hnormal ⟨_, Step.jump_ne (hp ▸ hinstr) heq⟩

statement: theorem step_confluent (p : Program) : Relation.Confluent (Step p) :=
proof_text:
by
  apply Relation.RightUnique.toConfluent
  exact Step.deterministic

statement:
theorem preserves_register {s s' : State} {r : ℕ}
    (hsteps : Steps p s s')
    (hr : ∀ instr, instr ∈ p → instr.writesTo ≠ some r) :
    s'.regs.read r = s.regs.read r :=
proof_text:
by
  induction hsteps using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
  | refl => rfl
  | head => grind [Step.preserves_register]

by
  have ⟨w, hw1, hw2⟩ := step_confluent p h1 h2
  have hn1 := isHalted_iff_normal.mp hh1
  have hn2 := isHalted_iff_normal.mp hh2
  grind

statement:
theorem halts_iff_normalizable {p : Program} {inputs : List ℕ} :
    Halts p inputs ↔ Relation.Normalizable (Step p) (State.init inputs) :=
proof_text:
by
  grind [Halts, isHalted_iff_normal]

statement:
theorem toHalts {inputs : List ℕ} {result : ℕ}
    (h : p ↓ inputs ≫ result) : p ↓ inputs :=
proof_text:
let ⟨s, hsteps, hhalted, _⟩ := h
  ⟨s, hsteps, hhalted⟩

statement:
theorem evalState_spec {inputs : List ℕ} (h : (evalState p inputs).Dom) :
    let s := (evalState p inputs).get h
    Steps p (State.init inputs) s ∧ s.isHalted p :=
proof_text: Classical.choose_spec h

statement:
theorem toHaltsWithResult {inputs : List ℕ} (h : p ↓ inputs) :
    p ↓ inputs ≫ ((evalState p inputs).get h).regs.output :=
proof_text:
let s := (evalState p inputs).get h
  let ⟨hsteps, hhalted⟩ := evalState_spec p h
  ⟨s, hsteps, hhalted, rfl⟩

statement:
theorem haltsWithResult_iff_eval {inputs : List ℕ} {result : ℕ} :
    p ↓ inputs ≫ result ↔ eval p inputs = Part.some result :=
proof_text:
by
  rw [Part.eq_some_iff, eval, Part.mem_map_iff]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨s, hsteps, hhalted, hresult⟩
    have hhalts : Halts p inputs := ⟨s, hsteps, hhalted⟩
    have heq : (evalState p inputs).get hhalts = s :=
      Steps.eq_of_halts (evalState_spec p hhalts).1 (evalState_spec p hhalts).2 hsteps hhalted
    exact ⟨(evalState p inputs).get hhalts, Part.get_mem hhalts, heq ▸ hresult⟩
  · intro ⟨s, hs_mem, hresult⟩
    rw [Part.mem_eq] at hs_mem
    obtain ⟨hdom, hget⟩ := hs_mem
    have hspec := evalState_spec p hdom
    exact ⟨s, hget ▸ hspec.1, hget ▸ hspec.2, hresult⟩

statement: theorem ProgramEquiv.equivalence : Equivalence ProgramEquiv where
proof_text:
refl := fun _ _ => rfl
  symm := fun h inputs => (h inputs).symm
  trans := fun h₁ h₂ inputs => (h₁ inputs).trans (h₂ inputs)
